description: Send one owned active RESLA Drone for 10 minutes to Garden or Library. Requires play + expeditions, UUID requestId. One departure/account/UTC day across clients. Free, no fuel or charges. Garden brings 1 random existing ingredient using Garden rarity odds; Library picks uniformly from public readable text works. Skip this account's last 7 finds per destination unless the pool is exhausted. Picks are saved at departure. That copy cannot be gifted/dismantled until collection. No equip required.
name: expedition_send
